brief.zh: 用下面的元件，把这句话拼成公式。
brief.en: Build this sentence as a formula from the parts below.

t.zh: 命题逻辑里，一个字母代表一整句话：要说每个人会不会死，每人就得用一个字母；「每个人」「有一个人」根本说不出来。
t.en: In propositional logic a letter stands for a whole sentence: saying whether each person is mortal takes a letter per person, and “everyone” or “someone” cannot be said at all.

t.zh: 把句子拆开：名字指一样东西，说一样东西是什么，或几样东西之间是什么关系。「苏格拉底是人」写作 Human(h)，「安喜欢博」写作 Likes(i, j)，位置的顺序有意义。
t.en: takes sentences apart: a name stands for a thing, and a says what a thing is or how things relate. “Socrates is human” is written Human(h), “Ann likes Bo” Likes(i, j): the order of the places matters.

t.zh: 翻译一句话，先找出它的骨架：连接词常常藏在说法里，「却」是「并且」，「不是……就是……」是「或者」，「只有……才……」是「若……则……」，但条件在后面。这一章先不证明，只学怎样说一句话，怎样判断它在一个世界里的真假。
t.en: To translate a sentence, find its frame first: the connectives often hide in the wording, “yet” is “and”, “either … or …” is “or”, “only if” is “if … then …” with the condition at the end. No proofs in this chapter yet: first how to say a sentence, and how to tell whether it is true in a world.

say.zh: 安是博的父母，博却不喜欢安。
say.en: Ann is a parent of Bo, yet Bo does not like Ann.

hint.zh: 「却」「但是」「而且」在逻辑里都是「并且」∧：两半句都成立。
hint.en: “Yet”, “but” and “and” are all ∧ in logic: both halves hold.

hint.zh: 「①是②的父母」里，谁是 ①、谁是 ②？¬ 只管后半句。
hint.en: In “① is a parent of ②”, who is ①, who is ②? The ¬ covers only the second half.

say.zh: 苏格拉底不是鸟就是人。
say.en: Socrates is either a bird or human.

hint.zh: 「不是……就是……」里没有「并非」：它说的是两样里至少有一样，用「或者」∨。
hint.en: “Either … or …” has no “not” in it: at least one of the two holds, so it is ∨.

say.zh: 只有博是人，安才喜欢博。
say.en: Ann likes Bo only if Bo is human.

hint.zh: 「只有 A，才 B」说的是：B 成立，A 就一定成立。条件是后半句。
hint.en: “Only if A, B” says: if B holds, A must hold. The condition is the second half.
